main_text_prose: Main-text Section 6.2 quotes this column in words: 'access to SH leads to a 3% increase in sales for entrepreneurs and a 4% increase for merchants. The effect on sales in the large merchants segment is not statistically significant (p = 0.501).' Flagged for the lead (Hull's main-text rule includes text discussions); coded as appendix.
notes: PRINTED-APPENDIX SPECIFICATION (Nov 4, 2026): outside the main-text sample; for the appendix-inclusive sensitivity analysis. Main-text ITT T2_c1_ITT_logSales re-estimated on the Large merchants segment only (2015 GMV of $1 million or more; authors' AppendixA56.R segmentation on the seller-level GMV2015, a pre-assignment characteristic). Separate regression per segment, not a segment-by-treatment interaction. Bar-Gill, Brynjolfsson and Hak (2024), eBay Seller Hub (SH) randomized staggered rollout. Seller x week panel, 23 Saturday week-ending dates 2016-03-05..2016-08-06. Treatment SHaccess = 1[WeekEndingDate >= TreatmentDate], absorbing; 6 in-window access cohorts (May 12, May 19, Jun 6, Jun 13, Jun 21, Jul 26 2016 = weeks 11, 12, 15, 16, 17, 22) plus the Aug 8 group, never treated in-window. gvar = gweek (first panel week with SHaccess = 1, computed on the balanced panel before any restriction; NA for the Aug 8 group); D = 1[week >= gweek] equals SHaccess row by row. Seller FE + week FE, no controls, no weights, SE clustered by seller (authors: lfe::felm, exactDOF = T). DATA: the package ships a 10% random seller sample (18,422 of 184,222 sellers); the full data need eBay legal approval, so the printed full-data values can be reproduced only up to sampling error. Log outcomes precomputed in panel_sample_analysis*.rds (build_panel.R).
replication_status: approximate (random_subsample: fixest = authors' felm exactly on the shipped 10% sample (coefficient to 1e-8; clustered SE +0.50% vs felm exactDOF, small-sample DOF convention); full-data coefficient not reproducible from shipped data; printed value rounded to 2 decimals; subsample TWFE within 1.96 subsample SEs of the printed value, z = -0.69)
